links.outcome: Uncertainty metric (semantic entropy vs perplexity) discrimination of incorrect LLM answers, AUROC
links.effect: Semantic entropy AUROC 0·76 (95% CI 0·75-0·78) vs perplexity 0·62 (0·60-0·65); in expert-validated subset 0·97 (0·91-1·00) vs 0·57 (0·405-0·68).
links.quote: Semantic entropy showed superior discrimination of incorrect responses compared with perplexity (AUROC 0·76 [95% CI 0·75-0·78 vs 0·62 [0·60-0·65]).

unlisted_practices: Semantic entropy as an uncertainty metric to flag unreliable LLM outputs

screen.practice: uncertainty-based flagging of LLM outputs (semantic entropy)
screen.reason: Empirical study testing semantic entropy vs perplexity as an output guardrail/filtering mechanism to detect hallucinations and incorrect answers from GPT-4o on medical exam questions.

primary.practice: uncertainty estimation via semantic entropy to detect incorrect outputs
